name: PASSION PARADOX
source:
A historian, jaded by her monotonous life, becomes obsessed with a 16th-century woman sacrificed to keep the world from ending. 

[From [url=https://radishsoftworks.itch.io/passion-paradox]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位历史学家厌倦了她单调的生活，开始痴迷于一位为避免世界末日而牺牲的16世纪女性。

[来自[url=https://radishsoftworks.itch.io/passion-paradox]itch.io[/url]]
